To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CityGML is a standardized, multi purpose and multi level data model that enables the integration of 3D data in SDIs.
CityGML is a standard for the representation of 3D urban models and that it can be used for different tasks in the field of disaster management.
CityGML is a multi purpose and multilevel representation for the storage and interoperable access of 3D models of the real world in SDIs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of CityGML in the context of a 3D city model for the City of Bonn.
a multi purpose and interoperable access of up to date 3D city model information.
the development of a multi purpose and interoperable representation of 3D virtual city models for the support of disaster management applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CityGML is a suitable model for disaster management.
the CityGML model can be used for all kinds of applications, but that the model is not yet optimized for disaster management applications, which is a task of the future.
3D city model data is a valuable asset for the disaster management domain, but that there is still a long way to go to fully exploit its potential.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CityGML data model provides an open and flexible basis to store 3D city model data, and to access them via standard interfaces.
3D city data can be stored in CityGML and can be used in SDIs.
CityGML is a flexible and powerful model for 3D city modeling, which can be applied for different purposes in different domains.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CityGML is a powerful tool for the exchange of 3D information between different stakeholders in the context of disaster management.
CityGML is a suitable basis to integrate 3D city model information in SDIs.
CityGML provides the necessary framework to integrate and interrelate distributed 3D data sources and to provide flexible and on-demand access to 3-D city models in SDI environments.
